integrity: Exact standalone finite-field arithmetic checks performed for primes 3, 5, 7, 11, 13 and complete pairwise determinant checks at supporting auxiliary primes. Uniform high-prime assertion rests on explicit symbolic kernel/pairing proof rather than finite tests. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Determines only p-rank of the integral graph-critical group for the prime-degree complex Fermat-surface line configuration. Does not determine full elementary divisors, other-prime torsion, special-characteristic lines, or Picard-lattice discriminants. Previously published all-degree incidence and rational spectra are credited; historical priority remains provisional.
title: Wild-prime critical-group ranks of Fermat-surface line graphs
